summary: OddOne showcases a single team used to auto-climb Meander Trial stages 1 to 60 in Season 8, reaching 9th place on the leaderboard. Departing from standard Aura setups, the team uses a Poison and Ice Devitalization core featuring Serpentemis, Durango, Theodemer, Feenja, and Anneliesis. Theodemer and Feenja form a powerful defensive combo granting Theodemer 10 seconds of invincibility and full ultimate energy upon lethal damage. Detailed gear setups, skill timing adjustments, and replacement hero options are provided for tanks, healers, and control roles.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Delivers massive Poison derivative damage and lowers enemy resistance by 35% via her passive, reducing team Accuracy requirements.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.note: Immediately inflicts Toxin stacks at the start of battle via his passive, triggering Serpentemis's damage burst without needing initial skill casts.

heroes.name: Theodemer
heroes.note: Provides a full-board taunt, Defense Up II, and 30% damage reduction, gaining 10s of invincibility and debuff immunity upon death when paired with Feenja.

heroes.name: Feenja
heroes.note: Offers immense Enlightenment-scaling healing and unlocks Theodemer's cheat-death mechanic.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Locks down enemy waves with knock-up and stuns while also providing healing, buff removal, and allied debuff cleansing.

heroes.name: Ripekas
heroes.note: A king of crowd control who knocks up, stuns, reduces ultimate energy, and applies multiple debuffs.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.note: Pairs well with frontline tanks by providing bonus max HP, strong healing, and personal invisibility.

heroes.name: The Dark Lady
heroes.note: Functions as a fantastic tank and disruption option if available.

heroes.name: Tamar
heroes.note: Applies stuns and buff prohibition across enemies.

teams.note: Auto-climbing team for stages 1 to 60. Theodemer's first ultimate cast is delayed to 10 seconds to chain after Anneliesis's stuns expire.

meta_changes: Season 8 features Ice and Poison paired together under the Devitalization elemental affinity.
Meander Trial stages 1 to 60 grant +100 Enlightenment to all allied units, heavily favoring Poison derivative damage and Enlightenment-scaling healers.
tips: Delay Theodemer's first ultimate cast to 10.0s so his taunt lands right after Anneliesis's opening stuns wear off.
Equip Rift Hourglass on your primary crowd control hero (or control tank) to accelerate skill cycles.
Put Gatekeeper's Staff on Feenja to convert overhealing into shields for the rest of the team.
When running Serpentemis, her 35% enemy resistance reduction allows DPS and debuffers to operate effectively with only 140-150 Accuracy.
Use the Glimmering Long-Eared Deer familiar for supplemental crowd control in Meander Trial.
Equip Sacred River's Revelation on your healer for teamwide damage mitigation.
title: 💥 1 Team FULL AUTO All Stages 💥Meander Trial 1-60 S8 Team Showcase | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
